tbqr.business.heading: Timeblock QR Gateway
tbqr.business.intro: Create governed QR short links for events, check-in, linked shop, missions, and partner flows. QR content contains only a Timeblock short link; sensitive routing data stays inside Timeblock.
tbqr.quota.title: TBQR quota
tbqr.quota.allowed: This business account can currently create TBQR short links and QR files.
tbqr.analytics.summary_body: Business analytics only includes TBQR links owned by this business account. API access requires valid token scopes: qr_links:read and qr_analytics:read.
tbqr.metric.total_scans.help: All scan attempts for this business account.
tbqr.metric.routed_scans.help: Scans routed after passing Timeblock safety checks.
tbqr.metric.blocked_scans.help: Blocked by disabled status, safety review, or domain policy.
tbqr.create.title: Create TBQR short link and QR files
tbqr.create.body: Business self-service creation only supports safe routing actions. After creation, PNG or SVG QR files can be downloaded; internal point redemption shop and admin paths remain inside Timeblock governance flows.
tbqr.form.title: Title
tbqr.form.note: If the action type is external redirect, enter an external target URL. If using an internal action, leave the URL empty and use a safe path such as /events or /shop.
tbqr.empty.label: No data
tbqr.empty.links.title: No TBQR links yet
tbqr.empty.links.body: After a business plan enables TBQR quota, the first governed QR Gateway link can be created.
tbqr.recent.title: Recent scan attribution
tbqr.recent.body: Scans route through Timeblock, so attribution, source, user agent, business account, and routing status can be audited. Member private data and raw security logs do not appear in the business console.
tbqr.analytics.page_intro: This page only shows aggregate analytics for short links owned by this business account; it does not expose raw IPs, long ledger hashes, member private data, admin notes, or security logs.
tbqr.analytics.filter.note: Analytics query windows are limited to 90 days.
tbqr.analytics.total_help: All scan attempts within the filtered period.
tbqr.analytics.unique_help: Only aggregate deduplicated results are shown; raw IPs are not exposed.
tbqr.analytics.conversion_help: Scan actions routed after passing Timeblock checks.
tbqr.analytics.blocked_help: Includes disabled, safety review, or domain policy blocks.
tbqr.analytics.referrer_help: Only aggregate referrer domains are shown.
tbqr.empty.filtered_scans: No scan data in this period.
tbqr.error.invalid_target_url: Target URL must be a valid http/https URL.
tbqr.error.blocked_domain: Target URL domain is blocked by Timeblock safety policy.
tbqr.error.invalid_target_path: Internal target path must start with /.
tbqr.error.admin_path_blocked: TBQR cannot route public scans into admin paths.
tbqr.error.metadata_object_required: Metadata JSON must be an object.
tbqr.error.short_code_generation_failed: Cannot generate a unique TBQR short code.
tbqr.error.redirect_url_required: Redirect URL action requires a target URL.
tbqr.error.action_not_self_service: This TBQR action type is not available for business self-service.
